verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Braintrust uses API keys and has permission groups scoped to organizations, projects, and objects. Nothing documents issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials, such as service accounts or restricted keys, for an agent. Permission groups are an adjacent access-control feature, not scoped agent credentials, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
